faqs.q: Sec. 6-94. - Liquor licenses; distance restriction eliminated.
faqs.a:
The fact that the building in which the malt, vinous or spirituous liquor is to be
               sold is located within 500 feet of any public or parochial school or the principal
               campus of any college, university or seminary shall not be a basis for the denial
               of an application for the issuance of any liquor license other than a special event
               permit subject to Colorado Code of Regulations 1 C.C.R. 203-2 § 47-1006, as amended.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
State Law reference—
Distance requirement, C.R.S. § 44-3-313(1)(d)(III).
